title: In coena Domini. Lectio secunda (Gaspar, Lamentatio Ieremiae prophetae)
desc: Gaspar van Weerbeke, Lamentatio Ieremiae prophetae, In coena Domini. Lectio secunda. 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Gas0501b), edited by Agnese Pavanello (Gaspar van Weerbeke: Collected Works. V. Settings of Liturgical Texts, Songs, and Instrumental Works, 2020); encoded by Roland Mair-Gruber. CC BY-NC 4.0. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
